result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and a painted center median. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of physical pedestrian refuge islands increase risk for people crossing.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps with tactile warning pads. However, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase pedestrian exposure time and potential for high-speed vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main thoroughfare increases the time pedestrians are exposed to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection of Broad and Jackson

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflicts
hazards.description: Potential for conflicts between pedestrians and vehicles making right or left turns across the crosswalks.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized control. While sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the long, undivided crossing distance across multiple lanes of traffic presents a significant exposure risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk in the foreground across the multi-lane roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or refuge island leaves pedestrians vulnerable if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a basic level of safety. However, the presence of parked cars right up to the crosswalks creates sightline obstructions, and the lack of curb extensions results in a relatively long unprotected crossing distance.

hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
